This is my decensored and partially colorized edit of Schweinchen31's Classic Doujinshi "I Absolutely Won't Be Fem-Corrupted...!!" and this will take a long time to complete, I had originally planned to have this all finished for April fools day but theirs just no way this will all be done by april so I am going to upload it in installments.
If you are wondering about the difference between the two sets, the first set just has a contrast filter over it that I think looks nice. If I think the images are to small I might all do an AI upscaled set as well, anyways please enjoy.
